officialTitle: AI in Software Delivery — Industry Q&A

chapters.title: Staff morale when non-engineers contribute code
Experimenting with tools inside vendor constraints
Choosing the right work and validating business value
Review workload and the changing engineer role
Local inference, security and hybrid infrastructure
Code quality, bugs and release frequency
Maintaining mental models and shared documentation

existingSummary: Jussi Hacklin, Viljami Kuosmanen and Sini Tistelgrén answer audience questions about AI in software delivery. They discuss staff morale, tool choices in regulated environments, business validation, engineers’ review responsibilities, token budgets and local inference. The discussion also covers code quality, shared documentation and how agile methods are evolving.
